propositions: Plan review and code review use partially independent discovery paths that allow inconsistent policy application across built-ins, project criteria, routing, and failure handling.
Implement one unified review-discovery architecture where both gates derive selection from an immutable effective-policy snapshot and share a typed discovery executor.
Code-review project LLM criteria require non-empty repository-relative globs; migrate project.review-phase-boundaries from empty list to ["**"] with corresponding documentation updates.
Implement rebar review-plan --retry to reuse successful prior outcomes and retry only missing calls with a fresh budget, refusing stale lineages before any model call.
Plan review must move to digest-complete success-only checkpoints while preserving chunking, concurrency, cache warming, and cancellation behavior; legacy checkpoints do not seed new path.
Workflow editor must display editable Authored Workflow separately from read-only Effective Policy and reject empty code-review LLM glob lists.
